headline: Israeli forces and settlers carried out 3,133 attacks against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank in October, a 53% increase
dek: Israeli forces and settlers carried out 3,133 attacks against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank in October, a 53% increase vs September (2,051). Of these, 1,764 were carried out by Israeli soldiers and 1,369 by settlers.
sources: Palestinian Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission, via Al Jazeera liveblog
fault_line: Settler violence doubled in a month: is this a breakdown of control, or control by other means?

sections.what_happened: Israeli forces and settlers carried out 3,133 attacks against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank in October, a 53% increase vs September (2,051). Of these, 1,764 were carried out by Israeli soldiers and 1,369 by settlers. Settler violence alone more than doubled vs September (647 to 1,369), often during olive-harvest-linked incidents, frequently under the protection or with the participation of soldiers, per the commission. Highest counts: Ramallah and el-Bireh 704, Nablus 636, Hebron 568, Jenin 224, occupied East Jerusalem 219, Salfit 217, Bethlehem 198.
sections.what_verified: Al Jazeera liveblog report of the commission's figures (single family).
sections.what_disputed: No IDF or Israeli-government response to the October count in-window; the commission is a Palestinian body, so its count is an attributed claim, not an independently verified tally. Do not present 3,133 as a neutral verified total.
sections.why_matters: 3,133 attacks in one month: the West Bank's October count jumped 53%, and settler attacks alone more than doubled — 647 to 1,369 — as the olive harvest turned violent.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (AJ liveblog 09:15 GMT = 13:15 ; missed by 1300 and 1400 scans) -- West Bank: 3,133 Israeli/settler attacks in October, +53% vs September; settler attacks more than doubled

totw_analysis: Our read: 3,133 attacks in one month: the West Bank's October count jumped 53%, and settler attacks alone more than doubled — 647 to 1,369 — as the olive harvest turned violent. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Settler violence doubled in a month: is this a breakdown of control, or control by other means?
